description: Defines internal structures related to arena decay and arena management in jemalloc, including arena decay state, arena state, thread data, and context structures.

classes.name: arena_decay_s
classes.description: Represents decay state for an arena, managing purging and decay intervals.

classes.name: arena_s
classes.description: Represents an arena, managing threads, extents, decay states, bins, and other arena-related data.

classes.name: arena_tdata_s
classes.description: Thread-specific data for arena context, including decay ticker.

classes.name: alloc_ctx_s
classes.description: Context structure for rtree lookups, including size index and slab flag.
